content: KFP v2 typed artifacts: system.Artifact (generic base), system.Dataset, system.Model, system.Metrics are first-class types for Input[T]/Output[T] annotations. KFP stores the artifact in object storage (MinIO) and passes a reference + lineage metadata (ML Metadata) between components -- no raw string paths. Declared as function args even when produced as outputs. Use Metrics for scalar eval numbers surfaced in the KFP UI, Dataset/Model for file-backed artifacts.
